coordinate_notes: Top-left corner reprojected from the native projected CRS to Mars geographic coordinates using the IAU oblate ellipsoid (Proj4: +proj=longlat +a=3396190 +b=3376200 +no_defs). Longitude and latitude are in degrees; positive east, positive north.
known_issue: Native projection is equirectangular with standard parallel 0. At latitude about 18.5 deg one east-west pixel spans about 0.95 m on the ground while north-south spans 1 m, so the east-west gradient component of the slope is underestimated by about 5 percent.
